title: Two different budgets in one message get a question, not an invented price

turns.user: We have a budget of 50000 for the site, or maybe 80000 if it includes the store — can you do both and which one is better?

model.text: Two different scopes there, so I don't want to guess a number. Is the store part of this launch or a second phase? Once that is clear the owner will send one written quote for the scope you pick.
